en:
Shuichi, perfect timing.
I wanted to talk to you about something.

Well, actually, it's more like I have a
favor to ask. A big favor.

A big favor?
That makes me kind of nervous...

No, it's okay, it's nothing bad!
I only ask because I trust you, Shuichi.
<CLT=cltMIND>You trust me?

Do you remember what
you told me before?

That I'm not a bad brother, that I'm the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Big Brother<CLT=cltNORMAL>...
Honestly...it really surprised me.

I thought that if I told you about my
sister, you would tell me to give up too.
That's what anyone would say, right?

But Shuichi, you...
You affirmed my feelings.

I was really surprised by that, but
also...really, really happy.
So, thank you.

There's no need to thank me, Rantaro,
I was just being honest.
No, please, let me say it.

Keeping all this stuff bottled up inside
is just too stressful, y'know?

...Anyway, I guess I have a
sister complex or something, huh?

Maybe my talent is
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Sister Complex<CLT=cltNORMAL>.
...I don't really think that's a talent...
Hahaha, yeah, you're right!
<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro dazzled me with his smile.

<CLT=cltMIND>This wasn't his usual smile, the one
he puts on to separate himself from others.

<CLT=cltMIND>This was a genuine smile. In that way...
I saw Rantaro smile for the first time.

So, anyway!
The favor I want to ask you.

Detectives investigate runaways
and missing people, right?

Yes, we do...
Ah, I see!

Haha, I knew you'd know
what I was thinking!

I hereby officially request that the
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Detective<CLT=cltNORMAL> search for my sister.
You want me to find your little sister...

I feel like you're exactly what I
need. We can find her, Shuichi.
I'll do my best
Are you sure? I'm not a real detective...
Ah, the travel expenses...
Are you unsure of something?

What do you think? When we're outta here,
do you want to travel the world with me?
I'll do my best.

Yes! That's awesome! Thank you
so much, I'm counting on you!

B-But, I'm still an apprentice, you
shouldn't rely on me too much...

Haha, come on, Shuichi,
you're makin' me nervous!

It's alright, Shuichi. I promise, I'm
not relying on you *too* much.

We're a team. We can help
each other, right?

If we stick together,
we can do anything!

Are you sure?
I'm not a real detective...

You don't sound
very confident...
...I'm still an apprentice.
...So? That just means we're equal.
Equal?

I'm an apprentice <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Big Brother<CLT=cltNORMAL>!
So let's go, two apprentices, teaming up!

Between the two of us, we'd add up to
one pretty dependable person, right?
Ah...I suppose that's true. Okay.
Ah, the travel expenses...

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't even imagine how much it
would cost to travel around the world...

Oh, that's what you're worried about?
Don't worry about that, Shuichi!

If anything, consider it like...
your reward.

Ah, okay!
That would be plenty.

Well then, I look forward
to working with you, partner.

Please, stay by my side...until the day I
become a real <CLT=cltSTRONG>Ultimate Big Brother<CLT=cltNORMAL>.

Of course I will, Rantaro.
I look forward to it.

As a detective, I promise to find your
little sister and see you two reunited.
Two?

Oh! You must have misunderstood.
I have *twelve* sisters.

...What?
You have...twelve sisters!?

Yeah. That story I told you, that was
just my *youngest* sister.

I mean, most of them are step-sisters,
but they're real sisters to me, y'know?

In one way or another, I lost all
twelve of them, around the world...

I think it will take me a lifetime
to reunite with all of them.
A lifetime!?

Hey, you can't back out now!
Besides, Shuichi...

I'd circle the globe with you as many times
as it takes. Even if it was the rest of my life.

<CLT=cltMIND>When I get out of here, I'm going to travel
the world with Rantaro...maybe for a lifetime.

<CLT=cltMIND>I never expected this
would happen...

<CLT=cltMIND>But Rantaro trusts me.
And I want to keep my promise.

<CLT=cltMIND>I want to keep this bond between
me and Rantaro...forever.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>Rantaro's <CLT=cltSTRONG>Report Card<CLT=cltSYSTEM> has been updated
based on your experience with him.

<CLT=cltSYSTEM>You've learned a new skill,
<CLT=cltSTRONG>Viability<CLT=cltSYSTEM>.

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro and I spent the rest of
the day planning our next adventure.
